summary.text: Wendell Felder is the Ward 7 member of the Council of the District of Columbia.

paragraphs.text: He was born and raised in Southeast Washington, is a graduate of DC Public Schools, and lives in the Parkside neighborhood.

Felder worked in the Mayor's Office of Community Relations and Services, the Office of the City Administrator and the Deputy Mayor's Office for Planning and Economic Development, later as Director of Community Affairs at Sibley Memorial Hospital and Johns Hopkins Medicine, and was a four-term Advisory Neighborhood Commissioner in Ward 7.
He holds a B.S. in political science from Bowie State University and a master's degree in urban and regional planning from Georgetown University.
